what: The book's What's new chapter reads for visitors: each line is something you can try (an ask, or a page of the site that opens as a link), in plain words without file paths, PR numbers, commit hashes or code names; new ways of asking are grouped by the skill they open; days are the visitor's own (Today, Yesterday) instead of UTC's; a day offers 'play all N on the stage' only for asks that answered live, so the walkthrough never closes the book onto nothing. The agents' entries stay on the growth card and in the ledger.
show: What's new in the book reads in plain words, by your own day
